title: Companions with a room
what: A companion added on the console with a room of its own and removed there, its console room, number and answerers written by the receiver and its agent's half by the agency.

title: The consult routes
what: The routes the consult tool asks: a line said in the consult room under an agent's own name, and the block an agent is shown of the other agents' work.

title: The router and the agency's hooks
what: The route table the service is built from, the bearer token check and refusal shape every route shares, and the agency's three hooks with the cache warmer's ping.

title: The instruction queue route
what: The route an instruction is queued on for an agent's session in a room, read by its state and withdrawn, with the notices a room or the owner is told.

title: The round openings
what: What opened a room's turns, read back with the verdicts a round left, for the console to stand beside the instructions they carried.

title: The owner's words from the console
what: The routes that put the owner's words, instructions and files into a room from the console, archived under a console number or sent on the room's road as the owner.

title: The console's room reads
what: The routes a room is read on: its rooms and their titles, answerers, windows and figures, read marks, people, a message's metadata and files, and a day's first message.

title: The sends route
what: The route an agent's send is asked of the running receiver on, and the route that answers which sending verbs a room's road performs.

title: Console talks
what: A talk the owner holds with the chat agent about an item or a document, handed over by bmo-job and answered as a round of the owner's private chat.
